GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091 (31 Oct 45) PH
(SCAPIN - 216)
APO 500
31 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Dojinkai (Dojin Medical Society).
1. It is directed that the activities of the Dojinkai (Dojin Medical Society) shall be terminated in China and Korea upon the assumption of central of these activities by agencies of the Chinese and Korean Governments, respectively.
2. Japanese personnel engaged in activities of the Dojinkai in China and Korea will be repatriated to Japan upon termination of the activities of Dojinkai in China and Korea.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
